mapper.select: select r.id as id, r.sop_id as sopId, r.memory_id as memoryId, r.memory_title_snapshot as memoryTitleSnapshot, r.created_at as createdAt, (m.id is not null) as memoryAlive, coalesce(m.title, r.memory_title_snapshot) as memoryTitle from `sop_memory_refs` r left join `memories` m on m.id = r.memory_id where r.sop_id = #{sopId} order by r.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into `sop_memory_refs`(sop_id, memory_id, memory_title_snapshot) values(#{sopId}, #{memoryId}, #{memoryTitleSnapshot}) on duplicate key update memory_title_snapshot = values(memory_title_snapshot)
